metaDescription: Join the Best 5 Days Prenatal & Postnatal Yoga Teacher Training in Bali. Learn safe pregnancy yoga practices, postnatal recovery techniques, and earn an internationally recognized certification at Bali Yoga School.
summary: A 5-day aerial yoga course blending classical asana with suspended movement in a silk hammock, open to beginners and advanced yogis alike.
intro: Aerial yoga, sometimes called anti-gravity or flying yoga, is a blend of classical asana and some elements of acrobatics and suspended movement with a silk hammock that is tightly secured at a high level.
Aerial yoga is not done on a mat, unlike traditional yoga. This is done above the ground level and hangs from the ceiling in fabric secured tightly to it.

Everyone is welcome to do aerial yoga. All progress in this class will be yours; if you are a novice, or have been practicing for years, that will depend on your commitment, practice and readiness to learn something new.

The hammock is considered the foundation of aerial yoga. The fabric is soft and smooth, but designed to support a person's entire body weight. Instructors alter the hammock before every class; it is set up to fit each student.

curriculum.title: Warm-Up
curriculum.summary: The class starts with simple stretches, breathing and movement to prepare the body to move in the air. Light spinal movement and shoulder openers help the body feel awake before the fabric is added.

curriculum.title: Hammock Set-Up
curriculum.summary: Each student sets up their hammock at the right height for their body. Instructors stay close by to ensure everything is correctly and safely adjusted before practice begins.

curriculum.title: Guided Postures and Flows
curriculum.summary: The teacher leads the group through a well-organised sequence of poses and flows, with clear transitions and variations for different levels.

curriculum.title: Aerial Inversions
curriculum.summary: Students practice partial or full inversions with full hammock support.

curriculum.title: Deep Stretching
curriculum.summary: Students use the hammock for positions that may feel more difficult on the floor, especially stretches for the hips, chest and spine.

curriculum.title: Savasana and Relaxation
curriculum.summary: Savasana is practiced in the hammock at the end of each session.
